senses.gloss:
इड् f. (also written इल् in Veda) [इल्-क्विप् वा लस्य डः]
—1 An offering or oblation, libation offered to the gods.
—2 Prayer, flow of speech.
—3 The earth.
—4 Food.
—5 The rainy season.
—6 The third of the five prayājas (इडो यजति).
—7 People or subjects. (pl.) The object of devotion.
.━{@Comp.@}: इड्देवता

ईड् €2 Ā. (ईट्टे, इडाञ्चक्रे, ऐडिष्ट, ईडितुं, ईडित)
—1 To praise; अग्निमीडे पुरोहितम् Rv. 1. 1. 1; शालीनतामव्रजदीड्यमानः
 R. 18. 17; नेडिषे यदि काकुत्स्थम् Bk. 9. 57, 18. 15.
—2 To implore, request, ask for (with two acc.); उपस्थाय मातरमन्नमैट्टे
 Rv. 3. 48. 3. ━Caus.
—1 To ask.
—2 To praise.

ईड् f.
—1 Refreshment, libation.
—2 Praise, extolling; Rv. 8. 39. 1.
